findings.body:
**Disable configured fetch mappings before fetching a base branch.**

At `src/adapters/forge-github/mergeEffects.ts:909`, `fetchBaseBranch('main')` can update local `main` despite the protected-ref guard. For example, `remote.origin.fetch=+refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main` force-updates local `main` when that branch is not checked out. Git applies configured destination mappings even when the command supplies a colon-less refspec. The guard checks only explicit destinations. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fetch))

Pin an empty `--refmap=` for these fetches and update the allowlist accordingly. Apply the same protection to `fetchRef`.
findings.title: Disable configured fetch mappings before fetching a base branch.

findings.body:
**Strip inherited repository-selection variables from the git runner.**

The git runner at `src/adapters/forge-github/mergeEffects.ts:821` scopes commands with `-C repoRoot`, but it does not strip inherited environment. `gitRunnerOpts` sets no `unsetEnv`, so an inherited `GIT_DIR` reaches the git child process. Git uses `GIT_DIR` in place of repository discovery, so the `-C` scoping does not choose the repository. When `GIT_DIR` points to another repository, reads such as `validateRef` and `isAncestor` and writes such as `fetchRef` and `pushRef` can operate on that repository instead of `repoRoot`.

The gh runner already handles this case. Its comment at lines 783–791 strips `GH_REPO` because an inherited value overrides the scoped working directory. Add the same stripping to the git runner:

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
   const gitRunnerOpts = {
     ...(opts.gitBin !== undefined ? { bin: opts.gitBin } : {}),
     ...(opts.timeoutMs !== undefined ? { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs } : {}),
+    // Repository selection comes from -C repoRoot. Strip inherited variables
+    // that would select another repository or worktree.
+    unsetEnv: ['GIT_DIR', 'GIT_WORK_TREE', 'GIT_COMMON_DIR'],
     // OBJECT-GRAPH HARDENING (review P1 p528, PR #1641): every gate read
```

</details>
findings.title: Strip inherited repository-selection variables from the git runner.
